rationale: Amdahl's law states that optimizing a small fraction of a fixed workload yields only limited speedup. The claim applies this directly to a communication profile in which all-to-all is only 14.5% of communication time, so overlapping it cannot remove the dominant pipeline and AllReduce costs. The performance-law logic and the system-level scale are compatible.
